messages:
Evan: Day 2 check-in — what I did: got macOS dev box imaged, installed nvm/node, ran `yarn start` for the docs site. Blockers: still can't access the private repo redwood/infra (403), corporate VPN drops every ~10m. Today: pair with @Sam to finish infra checkout, submit access request to IT if needed.

Sam: lgtm on the local steps, nice progress. I'll try to add you to redwood/infra now. Can you DM me the exact 403 screenshot or paste the curl error? Also let's do a 30m pairing at 11:30 if that works.

Evan: thanks! screenshot pasted: `GET https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/infra 403 Forbidden` and web UI shows "You don't have access". 11:30 works.

Priya (IT): hey @Evan — I see a pending invite for GH org that hasn't been accepted yet. Try checking email (inc spam). For VPN, which client are you using? macOS or Linux?

Evan: macOS 13.4, using the company OpenConnect profile from the onboarding doc. Client is `openconnect` via Homebrew.

Priya (IT): ok try killing the session and reconnecting, run:```sh
sudo pkill openconnect || true
openconnect --protocol=anyconnect vpn.redwood.ai
```
If it still drops, send me the output of `ifconfig` and `/var/log/system.log` lines around the disconnect. I'll also re-send the org invite.

Sam: I accepted a GH request for `evan` just now — you should see the invite banner on github.com. If not, @Evan try the browser in an incognito window. I'll hold the pairing until you're in the repo (we can still do env walk-through). :thumbsup:

Evan: invite popped up, accepted. I can clone now, running `git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra.git`. VPN reconnect command worked for a few minutes then dropped once — attaching the `openconnect` stderr snippet in thread.

Priya (IT): got the snippet. Looks like an MTU issue on your home router. Try adding `--no-dtls` to the openconnect command and see if it stabilizes. If not, I'll open a temporary bypass for your IP so pairing isn't blocked.

DevEx Bot: Reminder — new hires: complete checklist item "2. Repo access confirmed" to auto-close the onboarding task. (Visit /onboarding to mark complete.)

Sam: perfect. If VPN is flaky we'll do the pairing over local edits + `git push` once you can reach GH. Catch up at 11:30 either way.

Evan: will try `--no-dtls` and report back. Thanks both!
